CITY  OF  ALHAMBRA

  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE
  ALHAMBRA CITY COUNCIL
  (Notice No. N2M21-81)

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the City of Alhambra will be hosting a live, online community
meeting via Zoom about Alhambra's plans to cut traffic on our major roads on Wednesday,
June 16, 2021, commencing at 6:00 p.m. (See attached flyers)

To learn more about the project, visit: https://advancingalhambra.org/project
Register to receive the meeting link here: https://bit.ly/710Alhambra

It is intended that this will be a City staff/consultant run meeting and the discussion will focus on
considerations for interchange improvements at the Fremont Avenue on and off-ramps at the I-
10 freeway. However, due to the possibility that three (3) or more members of the Alhambra City
Council may attend this meeting, which will include a discussion of traffic in Alhambra as well as
the interchange improvements at the Fremont Avenue on and off-ramps at the I-10 freeway,
notice of a special meeting of the Alhambra City Council is hereby given in an abundance of
caution pursuant to the order of the Mayor of the City of Alhambra, the Alhambra City Charter,
the Alhambra Municipal Code and Section 54956 of the Government Code of the State of
California.

  LAUREN MYLES, CMC
  CITY CLERK

Dated:  June 15, 2021
Notice No.  N2M21-81
File No.  F2M19-32
